general.title: Video Promotion Agreement
general.subtitle: On-location reporting. Sponsored storytelling. Chris Cerney's channels.
general.introduction: This agreement is between Christopher Thomas Cerney, an individual professionally known as Chris Cerney ("Chris"), and the legal business or person identified in the accepted booking summary (the "Client"). The accepted summary identifies the package, price, billing plan, deliverables, filming arrangements, and any exclusivity agreement. The summary and these terms form one agreement. An initial inquiry is nonbinding. Chris must accept the request, and the Client must sign and complete the initial payment before the booking is confirmed.

sections.title: 1. Services and deliverables
paragraphs: Chris will produce the number of promotional videos stated in the accepted booking summary. The Reporter Feature is one video filmed on location for $600. Monthly packages provide the stated number of videos in each monthly service period. Unless the summary states otherwise, finished videos are approximately one to two minutes long. Posting the same video on multiple channels does not create additional videos.

The Client may share goals, key facts, people, products, services, and story ideas. Chris may develop the concept, narrative, script, and creative direction. A video may include Chris on camera, voice-over, interviews, other presenters, or a combination. Chris may use production assistance and appropriate existing footage, photos, audio, or graphics.

Filming scope, session length, locations, and interview needs must be agreed before acceptance. Shoots generally take one to three hours depending on the package and scope. Unusual outside costs, including paid actors, permits, location fees, special equipment, or travel outside Monterey County, require the Client's written approval before they are charged.

sections.title: 2. Price, payment, and recurring billing
paragraphs: The accepted booking summary states the amount and billing plan. A one-time booking is paid in advance through Stripe after signing. Chris does not have to film, edit, or post while payment is overdue. Signing alone does not charge a card.

For a month-to-month plan, the Client authorizes the disclosed monthly charge to the payment method selected through Stripe. The plan renews automatically each monthly billing period until canceled before the next renewal. Cancellation stops future renewals and takes effect at the end of the paid period; it does not by itself refund work already started.

A three-month exclusive plan is a $12,000 commitment, paid in three monthly installments of $4,000. It includes two videos in each service month, six total. The first installment is collected when the Client starts the plan, followed by two monthly installments. This fixed term ends after the third service month and does not automatically renew. It is not a cancel-anytime monthly plan. Early cancellation does not by itself erase the remaining installments, subject to Chris's failure to provide the agreed services, a written resolution, and rights that cannot be waived.

Once work for the applicable booking or monthly period starts, including planning, scheduling, filming, writing, or editing, that fee is nonrefundable except as stated here or required by law. If Chris cannot provide a paid video for reasons that are not the Client's fault, the parties will agree on a replacement or rescheduled video, or Chris will refund the amount paid for the undelivered services. For a $600 one-video booking, that refund is $600. For a partly completed monthly package, any refund will reasonably account for the services already delivered and the services not delivered. For an exclusivity plan, this includes any promised exclusivity that was not provided. No allocation of the fee to production or exclusivity is implied unless the accepted summary states it.

sections.title: 3. Filming, timing, and cooperation
paragraphs: The booking page shows offered filming hours and checks calendar conflicts. A selected time is a request until Chris approves it. The approval reserves the time pending signature and payment; final confirmation follows successful payment. Current usual filming hours are Tuesday through Saturday, 1 p.m. to 6 p.m. Pacific, subject to actual availability and the session length.

Videos are often posted within one week after filming. This is the usual target, not a guaranteed deadline. An exact launch date must be agreed in writing. For monthly packages, the parties agree on a posting plan so the videos can be spaced through the service month; that plan may intentionally place a post later than one week after filming. Future monthly filming sessions are arranged with Chris.

The Client must provide reasonable location access, available participants, and accurate information in time for production. Client delays, unavailable interview subjects, missing permissions, late materials, or location changes may move filming and posting dates. Unused monthly deliverables caused by a Client delay do not automatically roll over unless Chris agrees in writing.

sections.title: 4. Creative control and no revisions
paragraphs: Chris has final creative control over the concept, script, presenter, voice, shots, music, graphics, caption, cover image, tags, and final edit. No Client review round, revisions, alternate edits, or reshoots are included. The Client should provide correct facts and priorities before filming. Additional production or a different scope requires a separate written agreement; submitting feedback does not create an included revision round.

Chris may refuse content he reasonably believes is false, misleading, illegal, unsafe, against platform rules, or harmful to his reputation or audience trust. These terms do not waive any obligation or remedy that the law does not permit the parties to waive.

sections.title: 5. Sponsored-content disclosure
paragraphs: Each promotion will clearly disclose its sponsored or paid nature using disclosures appropriate to the content and platform. Chris controls the disclosure and may use on-screen or spoken disclosure, captions, and platform paid-partnership tools. The Client may not require the relationship to be hidden or the disclosure weakened.

sections.title: 6. Posting and account control
paragraphs: Unless the accepted summary specifies a different set of channels, Chris posts each finished video on his Instagram account @chrizcerney, his Facebook page, and his TikTok account. These are the same finished videos distributed across Chris's channels. Chris may adjust captions, covers, crops, and posting times for each platform.

The promotional post is published officially through Chris's channels. A collaboration post involving the Client's account requires a separate written agreement. Chris keeps control of his accounts and may edit, archive, unlist, limit comments on, or remove a post. Removal after posting does not by itself require a refund, subject to an expressly agreed live period or a remedy required by law. The Client receives no account access, passwords, or control.

sections.title: 7. No guaranteed audience result
paragraphs: Chris does not promise a number of views, impressions, likes, comments, shares, followers, clicks, customers, sales, reservations, or revenue. Follower counts do not guarantee that every follower will see a post. The fee pays for the agreed production, posting, and any expressly purchased exclusivity, not a guaranteed performance result.

sections.title: 8. Ownership and no Client reuse
paragraphs: Chris owns the finished videos and the production materials he creates, including raw footage, project files, scripts, edits, photos, audio, and unused concepts. Raw footage, editable files, and downloadable finished-video files are not included.

This purchase does not give the Client a content license. The Client may not download, repost, re-upload, embed, edit, repurpose, distribute, or use the finished video or production materials on its website, social-media accounts, advertising, or other channels. This includes organic reposting, paid ads, boosting, whitelisting, extracts, screenshots used as promotional assets, and new content made from the footage. The Client may not separately use Chris's name, image, or voice as an endorsement.

Any such use requires a separate written agreement with Chris identifying the permitted material, channels, purpose, duration, edits, and fee. A higher-priced package, monthly sponsorship, or category-exclusive agreement does not itself grant reuse rights. Materials the Client supplies remain owned by their respective owners; the Client grants the permissions needed for the agreed production and posting.

sections.title: 9. Client information, locations, and permissions
paragraphs: The Client is responsible for the accuracy and support for advertising claims, prices, offers, hours, ingredients, allergens, health statements, availability, licenses, and other facts it provides. It must promptly report material changes.

The Client confirms that it has permission to supply its materials and to film at Client-controlled locations. It is responsible for obtaining releases from people it asks to appear, including appropriate permission for minors. Chris may request written releases or exclude people or materials when permission is unclear.

sections.title: 10. Client responsibility for third-party claims
paragraphs: To the extent permitted by law, the Client will protect Chris and his production team against third-party claims arising from the Client's information, instructions, products, services, materials, missing permissions, or unauthorized use of content, and cover reasonable resulting losses and legal costs. Chris must promptly notify the Client and reasonably cooperate. The Client may not settle by admitting wrongdoing for Chris or placing duties on him without his written agreement. This provision does not require the Client to cover Chris's own unlawful conduct or another responsibility that cannot legally be shifted.

sections.title: 11. Term, cancellation, and suspension
paragraphs: A one-time agreement covers the accepted booking. A month-to-month plan continues for successive paid monthly periods until canceled before the next renewal. A fixed three-month plan lasts for its stated three-month term. The accepted summary records the billing and service-period dates. Cancellation requests can be made through the available account controls or in writing to cerneymedia@gmail.com.

Chris may pause or terminate for overdue payment, unlawful or misleading requests, threats, harassment, safety concerns, serious lack of cooperation, or a material breach. Ending the agreement does not erase sums properly owed or mandatory remedies. Filming changes must be arranged directly with Chris; changing a calendar entry alone does not cancel a payment obligation or release an exclusivity commitment.

sections.title: 12. Delays and platform events
paragraphs: Chris is not responsible for delays, removals, reduced reach, or failure to post caused by platform outages or restrictions, illness, emergencies, severe weather, government action, location closure, or another event outside his reasonable control. Deadlines move as reasonably needed. When practical, both sides will work on a replacement date or another reasonable solution. This does not remove an applicable refund obligation for services that cannot be provided.

sections.title: 13. Limits of responsibility
paragraphs: To the fullest extent permitted by law, neither lost audience performance nor indirect or special business losses are guaranteed or recoverable from Chris under this agreement. Chris's total responsibility for a claim tied to a booking or monthly service period will not exceed the amount the Client paid for that booking or period. This limit does not apply to any liability or remedy that cannot legally be limited.

sections.title: 14. General terms and signatures
paragraphs: Chris is an independent contractor. This agreement does not create an employment relationship, legal partnership, agency, or joint venture. There is no category exclusivity unless the parties separately accept the Category Exclusivity Agreement with a defined category, geographic market, and dates. Sponsored partnerships do not purchase control over Chris's independent news coverage or editorial decisions.

California law governs, subject to rights that cannot be waived. Any permitted court action must be brought in a state or federal court serving Monterey County, California. The accepted booking summary, these terms, and any signed exclusivity agreement form the complete agreement. Changes must be written and accepted by both parties. If a provision cannot be enforced, the remainder continues to apply.

Chris accepts the booking through the approval notice or his signature below. The Client then accepts the displayed agreement by drawing an electronic signature or signing this document. The signer must provide their full legal name, role, and legal business name and confirm their authority. The electronic record associates the signature with the exact accepted terms and signing date. Each party may keep a copy. For recurring billing, the Client must separately acknowledge the displayed amount, frequency, term, and cancellation terms before payment. Signing does not itself charge a card.

exclusive.title: Category Exclusivity Agreement
exclusive.subtitle: A defined category. An agreed market. Reserved for your sponsorship term.
exclusive.introduction: This agreement supplements the Video Promotion Agreement between Christopher Thomas Cerney, professionally known as Chris Cerney ("Chris"), and the Client identified below. It applies only after Chris has reviewed existing commitments, approved the exact category and market, and both parties have accepted this agreement. A request for exclusivity does not reserve a category by itself.

sections.title: 1. The reserved category and market
paragraphs: The accepted summary must name the Client's legal entity, one specific business category, the geographic market, covered channels, and the term. An undefined category or market does not create an unlimited restriction. Chris must approve the exact scope before signing and payment.

During that term, Chris will not enter into or deliver another paid or in-kind business sponsorship within the agreed category and market on the covered channels. Earlier commitments or exceptions must be disclosed and listed in the accepted summary; there are no unstated exceptions.

sections.title: 2. Two videos per month
paragraphs: Two promotional videos are included per monthly service period, six total for a three-month plan. Production, filming scope, channels, and timing follow the accepted summary and general agreement. Videos are often posted within one week of filming; monthly posts may be spaced through the month by agreement. No revisions or guaranteed audience or sales results are included.

sections.title: 3. Choose one billing commitment
paragraphs: Month-to-month: $4,000 per monthly service period, charged automatically until canceled before the next renewal. Cancellation takes effect at the end of the paid period, when exclusivity also ends.

Fixed three-month term: $12,000 total, paid as three monthly installments of $4,000, with two videos per month. The first installment starts the plan, followed by two monthly installments. This is a commitment to all three months, not a cancel-anytime plan. The plan and exclusivity end after month three unless both sides accept a new agreement. There is no automatic fourth installment.

Only the selected option applies. Stripe displays the billing dates before payment; the booking record retains them. Chris reserves the category for the fixed term when that booking is confirmed. A failed installment may pause production and requires review; it does not erase the commitment or permit undisclosed competing partnerships.

sections.title: 4. What exclusivity covers
paragraphs: Exclusivity covers Chris's sponsorship decisions in the defined category and market. It does not restrict independent journalism, public-interest coverage, incidental appearances, ordinary unpaid editorial discussion, or advertising independently placed by a platform. The Client cannot require favorable reporting or suppression of a news story.

Other categories, markets, and channels remain outside the restriction. Franchises, affiliates, new locations, or expanded categories are covered only if expressly included. Chris will disclose known conflicts before accepting.

sections.title: 5. Content rights stay with Chris
paragraphs: Exclusivity grants no content license. The Client cannot post, embed, repost, download, advertise with, or repurpose the videos or footage on its website or elsewhere without a separate written agreement. Raw footage, editable files, and separate rights to Chris's name, image, or voice are not included.

sections.title: 6. Changes, disputes, and acceptance
paragraphs: The general Video Promotion Agreement remains in force. This agreement controls a conflict specifically about exclusivity or its billing commitment. Changes require both parties' written acceptance.

If Chris cannot provide the agreed exclusivity, the parties will address a remedy for the restriction and services not provided. Any refund is not limited automatically to video production. Mandatory legal rights remain. The signer confirms authority and acceptance of the completed scope and selected billing option.
